final: WITH filtered_data AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, HGB, CASE WHEN `T-BIL` IS NOT NULL AND CRE IS NOT NULL AND CRE > 0 THEN `T-BIL` / CRE ELSE NULL END AS ratio FROM Laboratory WHERE Date > '1985-04-22' AND Date < '1994-03-14'), group_stats AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM filtered_data GROUP BY CENTROMEA), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM group_stats) SELECT g.CENTROMEA, g.avg_hgb, g.avg_ratio, CASE WHEN o.mean_ratio IS NOT NULL THEN g.avg_ratio / o.mean_ratio ELSE NULL END AS normalized_ratio FROM group_stats g CROSS JOIN overall_mean o WHERE o.mean_ratio IS NOT NULL
